# Mindmap Feature → Dogfood Integration Assessment

**Scope:** `/Users/liamellis/Desktop/apps/ultraterrestrial-resurrection/apps/app/src/features/mindmap/` and related routes  
**Dogfood source:** `docs/dogfood-output/report.md` (v0 deployed UI, 2026-06-21)  
**Cannibalization docs:** `docs/plans/2026-06-20-ufo-ui-cannibalization-audit.md`, journey map in dogfood report (CANN-1/2/3)

---

## Canonical render chain (apps/app)

```
app/(site)/research-canvas/page.tsx          ← Server Component, loads graph data
  → MindMap (features/mindmap/mind-map.tsx)
    → ReactFlowProvider + MindMapProvider
      → ViewSwitcher (research-canvas/ViewSwitcher.tsx)
        → canvas: Graph | timeline | globe | search | detail (lazy views)
        → always: FullScreenMenu
```

| File | Role |
|------|------|
| `apps/app/src/app/(site)/research-canvas/page.tsx` | Entry route; `getBoundedInitialGraphData()` + `StateOfDisclosureProvider` |
| `apps/app/src/features/mindmap/mind-map.tsx` | 16-line shell |
| `apps/app/src/features/mindmap/research-canvas/ViewSwitcher.tsx` | Zustand `activeView` switch; lazy-loads sub-views |
| `apps/app/src/features/mindmap/graph.tsx` | Live canvas: React Flow + empty/populated UI |
| `apps/app/src/features/mindmap/CLAUDE.md` | Architecture notes (dead code, nav rules) |

**Ghost routes:** No `app/(site)/search-and-discovery-interface`, `content-card-detail-view`, or `ufo-sightings` pages — those views exist only inside `ViewSwitcher` (not URL-routable).

---

## 1. Research Canvas entry

| Component | Path | Status |
|-----------|------|--------|
| Route page | `app/(site)/research-canvas/page.tsx` | **Wired** — SSR graph bootstrap |
| Shell | `mind-map.tsx` | **Wired** |
| Canvas | `graph.tsx` | **Wired** — agent, toolbar, empty state |
| Empty state | `research-canvas/EmptyCanvas.tsx` | **Wired** — loading/error/agent props |
| Console | `research-canvas/research-canvas-console.tsx` | **Wired** — typer + submit |
| View switcher | `research-canvas/ViewSwitcher.tsx` | **Wired** |

**Behavior:** Empty graph (`nodes.length === 0`) → full-screen `EmptyCanvas`. After nodes exist → `FloatingToolbar` + bottom `ResearchCanvasConsole` + action chips.

---

## 2. Query / command palette / submit flow

### Live path (canonical)

| Piece | Path | Submit / loading |
|-------|------|-------------------|
| Initial input | `research-canvas/MessageInput.tsx` | Form `onSubmit`; disabled send when empty |
| Expanded palette | `research-canvas/EnhancedAnimatedChat.tsx` | Animated expand → calls `handleSubmit`; shows `agentStatus` / `agentAnalysis` |
| Typer state | `research-canvas/typer/use-typer.ts` | `active` on keystroke; `showEnhancedChat` on card click or submit |
| Cards | `research-canvas/typer/CardStack.tsx`, `PinnedCard.tsx` | Topic cards (Guided Tour, Deep Research, Explore Network) |
| Agent hook | `hooks/use-mindmap-agent.ts` | `POST /api/disclosure/mindmap` SSE stream |
| API | `app/api/disclosure/mindmap/route.ts` | OpenAI Assistants + `searchDatabase` + graph tools |
| Graph handler | `graph.tsx` → `handleEmptyCanvasSubmit` → `runAgentQueryAndAddNodes` | Adds `userInputNode`, streams analysis, transforms search → nodes/edges |

### Alternate / not in render path

| Piece | Path | Status |
|-------|------|--------|
| OracleInput | `components/menus/mindmap-bottom-menu/oracle-input.tsx` | **Not mounted** in `graph.tsx` (Storybook/tests only) |
| MindMapBottomMenu | `components/menus/mindmap-bottom-menu/mindmap-bottom-menu.tsx` | **Legacy** — uses `@ai-sdk/react` chat, not disclosure mindmap route |
| Global command palette | `components/command-menu.tsx` | **Separate** — Cmd+K dialog with Escape; not tied to Research Canvas console |
| Launchpad | `components/launchpad/launchpad.tsx` | **Not in canonical path** |

**Wired vs v0:** apps/app **does** call the backend on submit. v0 dogfood dead-end (ISSUE-001) was a static prototype with no API.

**Remaining gaps vs good UX:**
- `EnhancedAnimatedChat` runs a **multi-second animation before** `handleSubmit` → API call delayed
- While `streaming` with no `agentAnalysis` yet, shows **placeholder Typewriter text** instead of a spinner (`EnhancedAnimatedChat.tsx` ~386–402)
- Submit button in `OracleInput` is `type="submit"` but **not inside a form** and has no `onClick` — dead if that component were mounted

---

## 3. Dismiss behavior (Escape / outside click)

| Surface | Escape | Outside click | Close control |
|---------|--------|---------------|-----------------|
| `FullScreenMenu.tsx` | Yes | Backdrop click | X button |
| `components/command-menu.tsx` | Yes | Dialog default | — |
| `EnhancedAnimatedChat` / typer palette | **No** | **No** | Only `PinnedCard` unpin → `handleUnpin` resets state |
| `FloatingToolbar` hover panels | HoverCard auto-close on leave | Partial | Pin toggles via `pinnedPanel` in store |
| Search view input | Escape blurs (`search-and-discovery-interface/page.tsx`) | — | — |

**ISSUE-002 mapping:** Same class of bug exists in apps/app — expanded command palette (`showEnhancedChat` / `hasSubmitted`) has **no Escape, no overlay dismiss, no coordination with rail panels**. Rail panels (`FloatingToolbar`) can open while palette stays open (z-index stacking).

---

## 4. FullScreenMenu — Timeline Explorer vs Network Timeline

**File:** `navigation/FullScreenMenu.tsx`

| Menu item | `id` | `setActiveView()` target | Actual view loaded |
|-----------|------|--------------------------|-------------------|
| Research Canvas | `canvas` | `canvas` | `Graph` |
| **Timeline Explorer** | `timeline` | `timeline` | `research-canvas/views/timeline/page.tsx` → **`NetworkTimelineExplorer`** (spiral node graph) |
| Global Sightings | `globe` | `globe` | `views/ufo-sightings/page.tsx` |
| Search & Discover | `search` | `search` | `views/search-and-discovery-interface/page.tsx` |
| Case Files | `detail` | `detail` | `views/content-card-detail-view/page.tsx` |

**Stale metadata:** `VIEWS[].path` is decorative (e.g. Timeline Explorer → `/ufo-sightings`). Nav uses **`setActiveView` only**, not `router.push` (per `CLAUDE.md`).

**Separate route — true 3D timeline:**
- `app/(site)/timeline/page.tsx` → `TimelineViews` → `ZAxisTimeline3D` when `viewMode === 'journey'`
- **Not connected** to FullScreenMenu “Timeline Explorer”

**ISSUE-005 mapping:**
- **v0 deployed:** top-nav “Timeline Explorer” → `/` (broken)
- **apps/app:** FullScreenMenu → `NetworkTimelineExplorer` via ViewSwitcher (**partial fix** — not home canvas, but also **not** the promised “immersive 3D Z-axis” view)
- **3D explorer exists** at `/timeline` (`features/timeline/3d-z-axis-timeline`) but is **orphaned** from mindmap nav

**`hooks/use-navigation.ts`:** Alternate helper with `router.push` paths (`timeline` → `/timeline`) — **not used** by `ViewSwitcher` / `FullScreenMenu`.

## 5. SearchView — autocomplete vs results overlap

**File:** `research-canvas/views/search-and-discovery-interface/page.tsx`

- **Data:** static `research-canvas/data/ufo-sightings.ts` (15 incidents); optional live path stubbed in timeline view only
- **Suggestions:** shown when `isSearchFocused && suggestions.length > 0` (absolute dropdown, `z-20`)
- **Results:** shown when `searchQuery.trim()` (separate block below)

**ISSUE-004:** **Same bug in apps/app port** — both conditions can be true; dropdown overlaps first result cards. No mutual exclusion (e.g. hide results while focused, or hide suggestions after blur).

**Ghost URL:** v0 had `/search-and-discovery-interface`; apps/app uses ViewSwitcher `search` view only.

## 9. Zustand `mindmap-ui-store` navigation

**File:** `store/mindmap-ui-store.ts`

- `ActiveView`: `'canvas' | 'timeline' | 'globe' | 'search' | 'detail'`
- `setActiveView(view)` — updates `navigation.activeView` (persisted)
- Also: `fullScreenMenuOpen`, `commandMenuOpen`, `pinnedPanel`, `activeTool`, tour/research session slices

**Pattern:** ViewSwitcher reads `navigation.activeView`; FullScreenMenu calls `setActiveView` + closes menu. **No URL sync** on view change.

**Default:** Store may persist last view across sessions — returning users might not land on canvas.
